items.title: Carnell Tate: Expected to play Sunday
items.body_text: Tate (back), who is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Texans, is "definitely trending" toward playing, a source tells Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jordan Addison: Pregame workout to determine availability
items.body_text: Addison (hamstring) will work out pregame before the Vikings make a call on his availability for Sunday's contest in New Orleans, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Justin Jefferson: Listed questionable for Sunday
items.body_text: Jefferson (ankle) will go through a pregame workout before the Vikings make a decision on his availability for Sunday's contest at New Orleans, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Zay Flowers: Expected to play Sunday night
items.body_text: Flowers (foot) is slated to play in Sunday night's game in Atlanta, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Keenan Allen: Expected to suit up Sunday
items.body_text: Allen (groin) is expected to play Sunday against the Steelers, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
